_comment: sim-robust-cart-place-goal-v1 place-on-cart GOAL fix. Purpose: make the COLLECT place-on-cart step PLAN and EXECUTE instead of dying at the deck place. The base drives in front of the rollwagen mouth (reposition_before_place, cart_cage_place false) and the deck place/preplace poses are reached by the host's seeded-KDL -> cuMotion nearest-branch IK. Those poses have TWO collision-free IK families: an UPRIGHT one (shoulder_lift ~ -1.9) and a DEEP fold (~ -3.57). Seeded from the folded carry config the host picks either the DEEP fold -- which the soft arm cannot HOLD under the carton load (collect1: shoulder_lift sagged 0.39 rad short of -3.596 -> PATH_TOLERANCE_VIOLATED -> 'arm command heartbeat lost') -- or a wrist self-colliding branch (collectsrc: 'Invalid c-space position: self collision detected', the 12-replan storm). These two HOST-config keys fix the GOAL branch. Merge them into the mission runtime-config HOST block (the block read by scripts/twin/restock_manipulation/ros_host.py). BOTH absent/false => byte-identical.
_collect_place_preplace_shape_note: ARM joint order (ur_shoulder_pan, ur_shoulder_lift, ur_elbow, ur_wrist_1, ur_wrist_2, ur_wrist_3), radians. The CPU-validated UPRIGHT clear-region preplace: FK TCP ~ the sensed preplace standoff (0.713, 0.196, 0.529) in ur_base_link, shoulder_lift -1.910 (low gravitational droop, so the soft arm can hold it under the 0.45 kg carton), wrist_1 -0.103 <= 0.65 and wrist_2 1.664 >= 0 (clear of the ur_wrist_2-vs-ur_forearm stop). Driven as a fixed collision-planned begin_joint_goal (like cage_preplace_shape) with a relaxed 0.2 rad terminal goal gate. Validated in tests/test_restock_cart_place_goal.py and data/sim-robust-cart-place-goal-v1/station-contract.md. Only active for the COLLECT preplace when cart_cage_place is false; absent => the pose-IK preplace (byte-identical).
_collect_place_wrist_guard_note: Extends the transfer wrist-guard clear-branch selection (transfer_carry.in_clear_region / wrist_flip_seed) to the COLLECT place + retreat pose-IK moves: a KDL goal outside the clear wrist region (wrist_1 <= carry_wrist1_cap, wrist_2 >= carry_wrist2_min; defaults 0.65 / 0.0) is re-seeded from its wrist-flipped twin (same TCP pose, clear branch) before the plain seeds, so the sensed-target place never seeds the self-colliding branch. Byte-identical when false.
_requires: The HOST block must already carry carry_wrist1_cap / carry_wrist2_min (BASELINE_REQUIRED; used as the guard region) and reposition_before_place:true with cart_cage_place:false (the non-cage reposition place this targets). Register both new keys in the run's --require preflight (config_preflight knows them as HOST keys).
_bounded_gpu_proof: Run the collect1 config (GT collect, RESTOCK_COLLECT_GROUND_TRUTH=1, visuals:false) + couple, through scripts/run_mobile_restock.py under /tmp/aile-gpu.lock, with these two keys merged into the HOST block. Expected PASS: HOST_EFFECTIVE_CONFIG shows collect_place_preplace_shape + collect_place_wrist_guard active; the place-on-cart reaches preplace via begin_joint_goal to the upright shape (no 'Invalid c-space position' storm, no deep-fold PATH_TOLERANCE_VIOLATED), the place pose-IK stays upright+clear, and collect reports placed on the cart deck. If the upright preplace itself still sags, widen only THIS move's goal gate (it already uses 0.2); if the place insert flips branch, confirm collect_place_wrist_guard is active in HOST_EFFECTIVE_CONFIG.
